book.name: Matyu
book.title: Weng Kal Ken Ati Matyu ete Bose te.

content: Seten-Ataanim em Yesus elo Kak Kelewse em Sang te.
Beli, Sunbin-Finik e “Seten-Ataanim e Yesus elo kak kelewoka!”, angeko, Yesus elo kawtiw banim dim kalo dabele unse kale.
Uneko belei, e wanin kulinba kebelei, akalkafo akalkafo 40 kel ding kelei, e yemen tew teinse kale.
Keko beli, Seten-Ataanim e elo kak kelewomin teleko, bokolewomele: “Kute Sunbin-Got em Min kelew tewe, tum kaleelo wanin keleweko, wana!”, dangse kale.
Dangei, Yesus e yan weng bokolewomele: “Sunbin-Got em fut tem e weng mak bokolomele:

content.text: ‘Kunum waneng im sunsun finik so biliw ibolow fukunin e wanin kaleemdiw emisik bate!
Nimin ete Sunbin-Got em finik so weng bete kuw kiliko, gelewiw tewe, bite kuw diwkuw finik so bókoliw te.

content: ange eli!”, dangse kale.
Dangei, Seten-Ataanim e Yesus elo Sunbin-Got akalem abiw mutuk fian kalo debeleko, Sunbin-Got em am yol am tikin dim mo koleweko,
bokolewomele: “Ku Sunbin-Got em Min tewe, kame yol mit una! Nimtew angom? Sunbin-Got em fut tem bokolomele:

content.text: ‘Sunbin-Got e akalem yemdakamin finik ilo weng kitil mak bokoyemei, i teleko,
Kekemiwi, ku yol mit telew tewe,
tum kang akal nam kene te.’,

content: ange kasike.”, dangse kale.
Dangei, Yesus e yan weng bokolewomele: “Sunbin-Got em fut tem akal bokolomele:

content.text: ‘Yu kanelom yukalem Kamok Fian Sunbin-Got beelo sak kak kelewbokoliw te!’,

content: ange eli!”, dangse kale.

Dangei, Seten-Ataanim e iti Yesus debeleko, amgu tikin tiakim dim mak mo koleweko, alik alik kunum mongom angom im aneng aneng angom beso, im on kisol so eisneng beso, alik alik eisneng be kukulewse kale.
Kukuleweko, bokolewomele: “Ku gatak wakas keko, nem wiin daonemew tewe, ne alik alik mesesem eisneng angom be fein kulo dukemoki te!”, dangse kale.
Dangei, Yesus e elo yan weng bokolewomele: “Seten-Ataanim ku asina! Sunbin-Got em fut tem e bokolomele:

content.text: ‘Yu Kamok Fian Sunbin-Got beem wiin ete kuw daolewboliwka!
Yu akalem wiin ete kuw dawsulboliwka!’,

content: angse kale.”, angeko, dangse kale.
Dangei, Seten-Ataanim e Yesus elo kolew unei, Sunbin-Got em yemdakamin finik i em mit mewso teleko, elo dokolewsiliw kale.
Galili Aneng kel Aluwbamin Kilse em Sang te.
Beli, deiw mak ding mak, Yesus e kililete: “Wonuk so kunum i Sion elo sok am tem da kolewsiliw kai!”, angiwi, e kilisomi, Galili aneng fian em

abiw mutuk fian Nasalet kalo unse kale. Uneko, akalem tanbelse abiw mutuk fian Nasalet be iti kolewsomi, Galili okmun beem mit mewso kele abiw mutuk fian Kafelneam kalo uneko, ka kel alenale kale. Aneng be, Sebulun so Naftali so, kunum mongom alew biim aneng kese kale.
Kanese beem dulum elote Sunbin-Got em bontem dim kunum Aisaya em sua kel bokose weng be fein dem gilase kale. E bokolomele:

content.text: Galili okmun beem dim biliw kawtiw iso,
Yoldan bang beleng beem dim biliw kawtiw iso,
Isalael kawtiw im ibik biliw Galili aneng kasel iso,
alik alik kunum waneng yu kilele kililina!
Kunum waneng kutiliw dim kakabiliw kawtiw i
Feinka! Kuanin atew keko, mililiw dim kakabiliw kawtiw im dim e dong fian mak ailoke te.”,

content: angse kale.
Emsik Kalan Kunum ilo Gaayemse em Sang te.

Beem ding dim kabalak e, Yesus e Sunbin-Got em kukuyemin weng bokolomin kilse kale. E bokolomele: “Yu ibolow sili sili kukuw koleweko, Sunbin-Got em kiin dim kiol kunum waneng keboliwka! Nimtew angom? Abiil tikin em gawman ding dim e kame mewso kele kasike.”, yangse kale.

Yangeko, Yesus em Galili okmun falal kakabe ding dim kabalak e, e awkunum kumel takam takamin kunum alew mak yetemse kale. Kunum mak em wiin e Saimon Fita ete te. Akalem awkunum em wiin e Andulu ete te. I takam wakal men so takam takabiliwi, yetemse kale.
Yetemomi, e aso ilo bokoyemomele: “Wee! Kaso yutaka! Kaso yu nelo nenggelew teliw kano, ne yulo kunum waneng kulamin kukuw kukuyemoki te.”, yangse kale.
Yangei, fein, aso i em bokoyemse weng be fein kiliko, fongate akate ikalem wakal men be welel koleweko, Yesus elo gelew unsiliw kale.

Keko beli, Yesus so aso iso kakabomeliwi, e iti awkunum kumel alew mak yetemse kale. Aso biim wiin e Sekow so, Sion so te. I Sebidi em muluwel keko, ikalem alew so kunuw dim bomi, takam wakal men benebomi, alenaliw kale. Biliwi, Yesus e aso ilo gaayemei, aso i em bokoyemse weng be kiliko,
kunuw dim ka biliw elote alew Sebidi so, kunuw so, alik alik be fongate akate koleweko, Yesus elo gelew unsiliw kale.
Wakamin so Kawtiw ilo Kilelyemse em Sang te.

Keko beli, Yesus so, akalem gelewkabiliw kunum iso, Galili aneng fian beem aneng aneng angom ka kakabiliw ding dim be, e Suda kawtiw im wensankabiliw am dim kel kukuyembomi, abiil tikin em gawman Weng Kal Ken Ati be bakayembomi, kal wanin auk so biliw kawtiw alik alik biilo kilelyembom, alenale kale.

Bomelei, kunum waneng i em kanese kukuw be atemeko, Silia aneng fian em kasel ikati kanese sang be kilisiliw kasike, i wakamin kawtiw so, betbet fian kebiliw kawtiw so, aneng matil tom yebe kawtiw so, sak walwal kuw kilikili kebiliw kawtiw so, teing yout yan yout nam kawtiw so, alik alik kawtiw biilo yemde teliwi, Yesus e ilo kilelyemse kale.

Kilelyemei, kunum waneng banso banso Galili aneng fian so, Dekabolis aneng fian so, Selusalem abiw mutuk fian so, Sudia aneng fian so, Yoldan bang em ataan talbe dulum ka biliw kawtiw so, alik alik i ikalem abiw kolewsomi, Yesus elo geleweko, eso makuw unsiliw kale.
